name: Code Block
description: A block of highlighted code with a file name or tabs, optional line numbers and a copy button.

props.name: code
props.description: The code to show when there are no tabs.

props.name: language
props.description: Any language id or alias the highlighter knows, such as "ts", "tsx", "css" or "yaml". Its grammar loads on the client when first needed; until then, and for unknown ids, the code shows as plain text in the same layout.

props.name: filename
props.description: Shown in a header above the code, beside the copy button. Without it, the copy button floats in the top right corner.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: Line numbers, counted from 1, to mark with a water wash and a bar on the left edge.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Show a column of line numbers.

props.name: tabs
props.type: { name: string; code: string; language?: string; highlightLines?: number[] }[]
props.description: Several files in one block, with a tab for each in the header. Replaces code, filename and highlightLines; language is used for tabs that have none.

props.name: labels
props.type: { copy?: string; copied?: string; tabs?: string }
props.description: Text for assistive technology, for translation. tabs names the tab list.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the surface. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
